verdict.rationale: Whether a spend-management SaaS publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows BILL Spend & Expense releasing its source code or naming an open-source license. The forkable Postman collection, API docs, llms.txt and documentation MCP server are developer resources, not product source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
